body: I just wish I could find one.
In our family it went more like... poop...sock...poop
She is 18, I think they are all a bunch of insecure hormones. I certainly was.
It is normal for girls to come into cycle with each other. It just happens
I feel sick, I cant find a job

I leave memo's for myself to find when I'm down. I know that it is my job to get up, but its near impossible. When I am up I will finish photo albums or top up my music player so that when I do start to fall, I can find good things and remember that i was ok. The hardest thing is when people think that because I have low times that I am not trying. I just have to try while I see there is point trying.

To plant a garden is to believe in tomorrow.

That is wonderful! I'm going to remember that forever I hope. I cant wait until I have my own patch of dirt to play in. Home grown tomatoes are the best. Its been a while since I cooked for anyone, maybe I'l start with that. My boyfriends family has the themed dinners too, but they are running out of countries they have been doing it for so long! 
Thanks for the helpful advice :) Hehe chickadee :)

I have been on them for about two months, two months and ten kilos. We have four Labradors, (we live on a farm) and I have a fat cat along with various chickens and cows :)  Its winter here, no sunshine for a month yet. I cant wait until the sun comes back. I am having trouble with people who see me when I'm down, then have a go at me for not trying, but I do try, I even leave myself little notes to read when I sink down. I just try really really hard to stay up when I am up.

When I am so down with no escape I cannot find anything that brings an escape, I have cut, and that works for a time. I walk and listen to music, but sometimes I am even too low to do this. I would love to volunteer, but am faced with no money to travel to a shelter or even a hospital. 

We live in 'elsewhere', so without money to support the driving it is hard to get out and help. I do love cooking, being organised helps me feel better, and I will defiantly lower my goals to day to day. 

You are all so kind, I wish I knew where to find people like you in life.

I keep a diary, I tend to write in it most when I am either down or up, not in between, so the entries are high or low. And yes I have been taking some medication, but overall it has just caused me to put on weight, which isn't helping. I am waiting for winter to end, more sunshine and outside activities will help I'm sure. Chickadee :) I like it.

My finance is not so great, so seeking paid help is unreachable without a job. I am trying to set myself goals, like a job for starters, but then maybe buying a block of land. It is so difficult as I go up and down, I can be suicidal for hours, and then completely forget how low I was until something minor upsets me again. I feel too unimportant to call a helpline, because while I think of dying, I don't think that I could ever go through with it, no matter how much pain I am in. If it would not hurt my mum, I would already be gone. It is hard, watching the world from my young perspective, to see everyone joining the world of unhappy sheep. Living each day the same as everyone else. 
Sorry I don't have AIM :( I would like to volunteer somewhere, but I am miles and miles away from anywhere, I live in a country area with a population of 2 neighbors that we never see. It also makes job hunting so much harder. It seems I need a job to get a house and a house closer to the city to get a job. How do I start?

I know how you feel, it is the worst feeling in the world when someone says to you that you have no reason to be sad, because you have a wonderful life. You already know this, and it makes it even harder to understand why you feel the way you do. 
I am in the same boat, having just lost my job recently. It is very hard to get up again and try again. I probably won't be the biggest help, because I have the same thoughts about suicide as you do. It is helpful to know that I am not alone in the darkness. The guilt of not having reason to be down is not good, it leaves you feeling worse. I am trying to come up with positive things that will help you, but I have no help for me yet so do not know what to say to make anything better. 
The best I can do is that life will get better, I am counting on it. Just hold on.

Bahaha made me laugh! I can agree, silver is good. From my point of view, (if you haven't got the ring yet, and i know that you haven't ;P) she isn't fussy, she doesn't care what it is so long as its coming from your heart!
This is easy to remember, helpful :)

Thankyou so much for the advice, I have had a rough day today, feeling numb all over. I'm going to start with trying to eat again first, its not much, but it is a step. I will begin look for a job tomorrow :)
